verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has its own first-party V3 REST API, with official SDKs, OAuth token refresh, a sandbox/production switch and an official MCP server offering full CRUD. Together these let it be driven programmatically without the UI. However, nothing documents CI or headless runs specifically, and the initial OAuth authorization needs an interactive callback, so unattended setup is not proven. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage guidance, a non-interactive service-account or machine credential flow, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: PHP client for connecting to the QuickBooks Online V3 REST API.
OAuth 2.0 authentication flow - Token management and refresh
production requires a public HTTPS callback for the initial authorization
full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports
